hero.name: Isaac N'CHO
hero.description: Crafting intelligent, secure-by-design, and user-centric digital solutions.

about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: An engineer's mindset, creative solutions
about.intro: I'm pursuing a master's degree in Cybersecurity & AI at ESATIC, with a strong interest in fields as varied as software development, data and AI, and offensive security. This broad curiosity leads me to understand problems from multiple angles, rather than through a single specialty.

philosophy.title: My Philosophy
philosophy.content: I'm as interested in how a system is built as in how it can be compromised. This dual perspective — building and questioning — shapes how I approach every project, whether it's technical, data-driven, or security-focused.

items.title: Security-First
items.description: Every project starts with threat modeling and secure architecture design.

items.title: User-Centric
items.description: Technology should solve real problems, not create new ones.

items.title: Continuous Learning
items.description: The tech landscape evolves daily. So do I.

projects.title: Selected Work
projects.subtitle: Projects that showcase my engineering capabilities

mamaci.title: MamaCi (1st Prize JDN Hackathon)
mamaci.description: Maternal and child health mobile application for Côte d'Ivoire.
mamaci.longDescription: MamaCi supports pregnant women and young mothers using their CMU ID. It features a personalized appointment calendar, vaccination reminders, an AI chatbot for guidance, and health center mapping. Designed with a simplified mode for unstable connections and a practitioner interface for electronic health records.
highlights: 1st Prize Winner at the JDN Hackathon
Integrated healthcare orientation and advice chatbot
Automated tracking calendar for pregnancy and vaccinations
Accessibility-focused design for unstable network conditions

studyspace.title: StudySpace
studyspace.description: Collaborative study platform with real-time tools and organized workspaces.
studyspace.longDescription: A comprehensive collaborative study platform designed for students. Features organized workspaces, timed study sessions with auto-save, integrated whiteboard and note-taking tools. Built to replace fragmented toolsets (Discord + Google Docs) with a unified, distraction-free environment.
highlights: Real-time whiteboard and note-taking integration
Automated session tracking with auto-save
Workspace management with invite system
Modern mobile-first UI with Shadcn/ui

akiba-hub.title: AkibaHub
akiba-hub.description: Economic intelligence platform for the Ivorian agri-food sector (Private Enterprise Project)
akiba-hub.longDescription: A comprehensive economic intelligence platform designed for the Ivorian agri-food sector. As a Private Enterprise Project, source code is not available. The system combines automated data collection from external APIs (like FAOSTAT) with dynamic visualization of economic indicators, serving as a strategic decision-support tool.
highlights: Designed 3-tier architecture (React/NestJS/FastAPI)
Automated data collection pipelines
Real-time KPI dashboards and alert systems
Unified Process (UP) methodology with UML

xpense.title: Xpense
xpense.description: Real-time expense tracking with intelligent categorization
xpense.longDescription: A comprehensive expense management solution built with ReactJS and Firebase. Features real-time synchronization across devices, automated expense categorization, and insightful financial analytics.
highlights: Real-time data synchronization with Firebase Realtime Database
Interactive dashboards with spending analytics
Generation of monthly financial reports
Smart notifications for important events
Chatbot as a financial assistant to answer user questions

industry-4.title: Industry 4.0 - Livestock AI
industry-4.description: AI-driven livestock optimization for sustainable farming
industry-4.longDescription: An innovative AI solution for livestock management that leverages machine learning to optimize feeding schedules, health monitoring, and resource allocation for sustainable farming practices.
highlights: Led a team of 4 developers in agile methodology
Implemented predictive models for livestock health monitoring
Reduced resource waste by 30% through optimized scheduling
Integrated real-time sensor data processing

e-docs.title: E-Docs
e-docs.description: Digital library and documentation management system
e-docs.longDescription: A modern documentation platform designed for educational institutions, featuring advanced search capabilities, version control, and collaborative editing features.
highlights: Full-text search with Elasticsearch integration
Document versioning and change tracking
Role-based access control system
RESTful API with comprehensive documentation

networking-lab.title: Networking Lab - DHCPv4 & SLAAC IPv6
networking-lab.description: Comparative analysis of IPv4 and IPv6 addressing mechanisms
networking-lab.longDescription: A comprehensive networking lab simulating and comparing stateful DHCPv4 and stateless SLAAC IPv6 mechanisms in a virtualized environment. Features deep packet analysis to observe protocol transitions and security implications.
highlights: Simulated DHCPv4 Stateful and SLAAC IPv6 Stateless mechanisms
Deep packet analysis with Wireshark and tshark
Analyzed transition from ARP to Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP)
Documented IPv6 Privacy Extensions and Multicast transitions

linux-adds.title: Linux Infrastructure Services (ADDS)
linux-adds.description: Centralized authentication and network services deployment on Debian
linux-adds.longDescription: A robust enterprise-grade infrastructure deployment featuring an Active Directory-like environment on Linux. Includes centralized authentication with OpenLDAP and SSSD, integrated DNS/DHCP services, and a comprehensive backup strategy.
highlights: Implemented centralized identity management with OpenLDAP
Configured unified authentication using SSSD
Deployed integrated DNS and DHCP services
Designed and implemented an automated backup strategy

pl-inference.title: Premier League Performance Inference
pl-inference.description: Inferential analysis of factors determining football match results
pl-inference.longDescription: Statistical analysis project using Multinomial Logistic Regression to understand factors influencing PL match outcomes, focusing on efficiency, level, and discipline.
highlights: Built Multinomial Logistic Regression model with 57.85% accuracy
Quantified impact of efficiency on victory probability
Conducted significance tests using P-values and Odds Ratios
Data cleaning and feature engineering on 2019-2025 sports data

wine-analysis.title: Wine Sales Data Analysis
wine-analysis.description: Data reconciliation and sales performance analysis for a wine merchant
wine-analysis.longDescription: Infrastructure transformation through ERP/CMS data reconciliation, outlier detection, and product segmentation.
highlights: Reconciled disconnected ERP and CMS datasets
Detected price outliers using Z-score and IQR methods
Segmented product profiles using K-Means Clustering
Modeled price-sales relationships via Linear Regression

tp1-intrusion-detection.title: Network Intrusion Detection
tp1-intrusion-detection.description: Machine learning model to detect network intrusions
tp1-intrusion-detection.longDescription: Academic project focused on building a machine learning model to analyze network traffic and detect potential intrusions or malicious activities.
highlights: Data preprocessing and feature engineering on network traffic logs
Implementation of classification algorithms for anomaly detection
Model evaluation using precision, recall, and F1-score

tp2-fraud-detection.title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
tp2-fraud-detection.description: Anomaly detection system for fraudulent credit card transactions
tp2-fraud-detection.longDescription: Academic project aiming to identify fraudulent credit card transactions using anomaly detection and classification techniques on highly imbalanced datasets.
highlights: Handling highly imbalanced data (e.g., SMOTE, undersampling)
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on transaction features
Training and tuning classification models

tp3-phishing-detection.title: Phishing Website Detection
tp3-phishing-detection.description: Classification model to identify malicious phishing websites
tp3-phishing-detection.longDescription: Academic project developing a machine learning classifier to determine whether a given website is a phishing attempt based on its URL and structural features.
highlights: Feature extraction from URLs and web page metadata
Comparison of multiple classification algorithms
Achieved high accuracy in distinguishing legitimate and phishing sites

tp4-malware-detection.title: Malware Detection
tp4-malware-detection.description: Machine learning approach for static malware detection
tp4-malware-detection.longDescription: Academic project utilizing machine learning for static analysis of software to detect malware signatures and suspicious patterns.
highlights: Static analysis and feature extraction from executables
Building a robust classification model for malware detection
Evaluation of model performance and false positive rates
